# captured 2026-10-18 · image ubuntu:24.04@sha256:68ee22004a9109b44973313b02ff7b1de250f1de0f5ecb628d73f579aaff33ac · cat /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/50-realm.rules
polkit.addRule(function(action, subject) {
  if (action.id == "org.freedesktop.systemd1.manage-units" && subject.user == "agent") return polkit.Result.YES;
  if (action.id == "org.freedesktop.policykit.exec" && subject.user == "agent") return polkit.Result.NO;
});
